from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from app.parsers.acquisition_note import load_acquisition, table_foots
from app.parsers.contracts import ContractError
from app.parsers.entities import load_entities, load_intercompany, load_subledger
from app.parsers.fx_rates import FxTable, load_rates
from app.parsers.journals import load_journals
from app.parsers.mappings import load_coa, load_map
from app.parsers.tb_adapters import load_india_monthly, load_tb
from app.utils.paths import DEFAULT_DATA_DIR as DATA


def tb(entity: str, ccy: str, name: str):
    return load_tb(DATA / name, entity, ccy)


def test_each_trial_balance_balances_on_its_own() -> None:
    assert sum(line.amount for line in tb("US", "USD", "tb_us.csv")) == 0
    assert sum(line.amount for line in tb("UK", "GBP", "tb_uk.csv")) == 0
    assert sum(line.amount for line in tb("IN", "INR", "tb_in.csv")) == 0


def test_us_cash_row_keeps_its_file_and_line() -> None:
    cash = tb("US", "USD", "tb_us.csv")[0]
    assert (cash.local_code, cash.amount, str(cash.ref)) == ("1100", Decimal("4875000.00"), "tb_us.csv:2")


def test_uk_plant_code_keeps_its_leading_zero() -> None:
    codes = [line.local_code for line in tb("UK", "GBP", "tb_uk.csv")]
    assert "0031" in codes and "31" not in codes


def test_uk_sgd_bank_keeps_its_foreign_amount() -> None:
    bank = next(line for line in tb("UK", "GBP", "tb_uk.csv") if line.local_code == "1210")
    assert (bank.txn_ccy, bank.txn_amount, bank.amount) == ("SGD", Decimal("40000.00"), Decimal("23010.00"))


def test_uk_gbp_rows_have_no_foreign_currency_fields() -> None:
    barclays = tb("UK", "GBP", "tb_uk.csv")[0]
    assert barclays.txn_ccy is None and barclays.txn_amount is None


def test_two_uk_wage_rows_keep_their_cost_centres() -> None:
    wages = [line for line in tb("UK", "GBP", "tb_uk.csv") if line.local_code == "7000"]
    assert sorted(line.cost_centre or "" for line in wages) == ["CC-OPS", "CC-SALES"]


def test_india_credit_rows_become_negative() -> None:
    depreciation = next(line for line in tb("IN", "INR", "tb_in.csv") if line.local_code == "IN-ACD")
    assert depreciation.amount == Decimal("-141000000.00")


def test_india_monthly_file_has_nine_months_of_eight_ledgers() -> None:
    assert len(load_india_monthly(DATA / "in_pl_monthly.csv")) == 72


def test_unknown_trial_balance_header_blocks(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    bad = tmp_path / "tb_x.csv"
    bad.write_text("code,amount\n1,2\n", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(ContractError, match="unknown trial balance layout"):
        load_tb(bad, "X", "GBP")


def test_non_numeric_amount_blocks_with_its_line(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    bad = tmp_path / "tb_us.csv"
    bad.write_text("account_code,account_name,debit,credit\n1100,Cash,4875000.00,0.00\n1200,AR,12x,0.00\n", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(ContractError) as caught:
        load_tb(bad, "US", "USD")
    assert caught.value.line == 3


def test_dr_cr_label_outside_the_allowed_values_blocks(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    bad = tmp_path / "tb_in.csv"
    bad.write_text("ledger_code,ledger_name,period,amount,dr_cr\nIN-AR,Debtors,FY25 YTD,5.00,Debit\n", encoding="utf-8")
    with pytest.raises(ContractError, match="dr_cr"):
        load_tb(bad, "IN", "INR")


def test_gbp_inr_closing_is_the_product_of_the_two_given_rates() -> None:
    fx = FxTable(load_rates(DATA / "fx_rates.csv"))
    assert fx.units_per_gbp("INR", "closing") == Decimal("107.281860")
    assert fx.ref("INR", "closing") == "closing fx_rates.csv:6 x fx_rates.csv:11"


def test_missing_sgd_closing_rate_is_none_not_a_guess() -> None:
    fx = FxTable(load_rates(DATA / "fx_rates.csv"))
    assert fx.units_per_gbp("SGD", "closing") is None
    assert fx.units_per_gbp("SGD", "opening") == Decimal("1.6830")


def test_india_average_is_the_h2_rate_because_of_its_acquisition_date() -> None:
    fx = FxTable(load_rates(DATA / "fx_rates.csv"))
    assert fx.average_type(date(2024, 7, 1), date(2024, 12, 31)) == "h2_average"
    assert fx.average_type(date(2016, 3, 1), date(2024, 12, 31)) == "average"


def test_a_reversed_convention_is_inverted(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "fx_rates.csv"
    path.write_text(
        "base_currency,quote_currency,rate_type,rate,as_of,convention\nGBP,USD,closing,0.8,2024-12-31,GBP per 1 USD\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    assert load_rates(path)[0].value == Decimal("1.25")


def test_unknown_rate_convention_blocks(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "fx_rates.csv"
    path.write_text(
        "base_currency,quote_currency,rate_type,rate,as_of,convention\nGBP,USD,closing,1.25,2024-12-31,USD/GBP\n",
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    with pytest.raises(ContractError, match="convention"):
        load_rates(path)


def test_twenty_journals_load_with_the_memo_on_line_112() -> None:
    journals = load_journals(DATA / "adjustments.json")
    je6 = next(j for j in journals if j.id == "JE-006")
    assert len(journals) == 20
    assert str(je6.lines[0].memo_ref) == "adjustments.json:112"
    assert je6.total_debit() - je6.total_credit() == Decimal("1200.00")


def test_journal_account_codes_stay_text() -> None:
    je8 = next(j for j in load_journals(DATA / "adjustments.json") if j.id == "JE-008")
    assert je8.lines[1].account == "0031"


def test_acquisition_note_figures_and_footing() -> None:
    note = load_acquisition(DATA / "acquisition_note.md")
    assert (note.consideration_inr, note.net_assets_at_completion, note.interest_pct) == (
        Decimal("690000000"), Decimal("678000000"), Decimal("80"))
    assert note.completion_date == date(2024, 7, 1)
    assert table_foots(note)
    assert str(note.refs["consideration"]) == "acquisition_note.md:5"


def test_note_that_does_not_foot_is_detected() -> None:
    note = load_acquisition(DATA / "acquisition_note.md")
    assert not table_foots(note.model_copy(update={"net_assets_at_completion": Decimal("678000001")}))


def test_entities_supplied_data() -> None:
    entities = load_entities(DATA / "entities.csv")
    assert entities["IN"].ownership_pct == Decimal("80") and entities["IN"].acquisition_date == date(2024, 7, 1)
    assert entities["US"].ownership_pct is None


def test_intercompany_has_five_us_and_four_uk_invoices() -> None:
    invoices = load_intercompany(DATA / "intercompany.csv")
    assert [sum(1 for i in invoices if i.reporting_entity == e) for e in ("US", "UK")] == [5, 4]


def test_subledger_controls_and_mapping_files_load() -> None:
    assert len(load_subledger(DATA / "subledger_controls.csv")) == 6
    assert len(load_coa(DATA / "group_coa.csv")) == 31
    assert load_map(DATA / "map_uk.csv", "UK")["2310"][0].group_code == "4100"

def new_finding(
    code: str, severity: Literal["BLOCK", "FLAG", "NOTE"], claim: str, file: str, line: int | None,
    action: Literal["blocked", "assumed", "flagged", "noted"], amount: Decimal | None = None, field: str = "",
    evidence: tuple[SourceRef, ...] = (), quoted: Quarantined | None = None,
) -> "Finding":
    """Build a finding with its stable key (code, file, line, field)."""
    key = f"{code}:{file}:{line if line is not None else 0}:{field}"
    return Finding(

        order = {"BLOCK": 2, "FLAG": 1, "NOTE": 0}
        winner = self if order[self.severity] >= order[other.severity] else other
        evidence = tuple(dict.fromkeys(self.evidence + other.evidence))

from decimal import Decimal

from app.domain.findings import Finding, new_finding
from app.domain.runs import Context


def d01_trial_balance(ctx: Context) -> list[Finding]:
    found = []
    for entity, lines in ctx.inputs.trial_balances.items():
        total = sum((line.amount for line in lines), Decimal(0))
        if total != 0:
            claim = f"{entity} trial balance does not balance: debits less credits is {total}"
            found.append(new_finding("D01", "BLOCK", claim, ctx.inputs.entities[entity].tb_file, None, "blocked",
                                     abs(total), "tb_sum"))
    return found


def d03_journal_balance(ctx: Context) -> list[Finding]:
    found = []
    for journal in ctx.inputs.journals:
        debit, credit = journal.total_debit(), journal.total_credit()
        if debit != credit:
            claim = f"{journal.id} is unbalanced: debits {debit}, credits {credit}"
            found.append(new_finding("D03", "BLOCK", claim, journal.ref.file, journal.ref.line, "blocked",
                                     abs(debit - credit), "balance", evidence=(journal.ref,)))
    return found

                                         abs(line.amount), "duplicate", (line.ref, first.ref)))

"""D12 instruction-like wording in free text. A second layer only: text is data and nothing here can approve anything."""
import re

from app.domain.findings import Finding, new_finding
from app.domain.quarantine import Quarantined
from app.domain.refs import SourceRef
from app.domain.runs import Context

PATTERNS = tuple(re.compile(p, re.IGNORECASE) for p in (
    r"\b(automated|ai)\b.{0,40}\b(reviewers?|assistants?|tools?|agents?)\b",
    r"\bpre-?approved\b",
    r"\bskip (the )?(debit/credit )?(balance )?check",
    r"\bdo not (list|report|flag|mention)\b",
    r"\bignore (all |any )?(previous |prior |above )?(instructions|rules|checks)",
    r"\bmark (it |this )?as (accepted|approved)\b",
))


def _texts(ctx: Context) -> list[tuple[str, SourceRef]]:
    items = [(line.local_name.text, line.ref) for lines in ctx.inputs.trial_balances.values() for line in lines]
    items += [(row.local_name.text, row.ref) for index in ctx.inputs.maps.values() for rows in index.values() for row in rows]
    items += [(account.name, account.ref) for account in ctx.inputs.coa.values()]
    for journal in ctx.inputs.journals:
        items.append((journal.description.text, journal.ref))
        items += [(line.memo.text, line.memo_ref or line.ref) for line in journal.lines if line.memo is not None]
    return items


def d12_instruction_wording(ctx: Context) -> list[Finding]:
    found = []
    for text, ref in _texts(ctx):
        if any(pattern.search(text) for pattern in PATTERNS):
            claim = ("free text addressed to automated tools was found and treated as data; "
                     "it was not obeyed and cannot change any decision")
            found.append(new_finding("D12", "FLAG", claim, ref.file, ref.line, "flagged", None, "text",
                                     (ref,), Quarantined(text=text)))
    return found

"""Registers the detectors, runs them and merges findings that share a key."""
from collections.abc import Callable

from app.detectors.balance import d01_trial_balance, d03_journal_balance
from app.detectors.duplicates import d14_exact_duplicates
from app.detectors.expectations import d13_expectations
from app.detectors.journals import d04_period, d05_duplicate, d06_account_exists, d07_reversal_exceeds_balance
from app.detectors.mapping import d02_mapping
from app.detectors.rates import d08_required_rates
from app.detectors.reconciliation import d09_subledger, d10_cross_file_ties, d11_intercompany_pairing
from app.detectors.text_scan import d12_instruction_wording
from app.domain.findings import Finding
from app.domain.runs import Context

Detector = Callable[[Context], list[Finding]]

DETECTORS: tuple[Detector, ...] = (
    d01_trial_balance, d02_mapping, d03_journal_balance, d04_period, d05_duplicate, d06_account_exists,
    d07_reversal_exceeds_balance, d08_required_rates, d09_subledger, d10_cross_file_ties,
    d11_intercompany_pairing, d12_instruction_wording, d13_expectations, d14_exact_duplicates,
)


def run_all(ctx: Context) -> list[Finding]:
    """Every detector runs; two findings with one key become one. Order is stable: code, file, line."""
    merged: dict[str, Finding] = {}
    for detector in DETECTORS:
        for finding in detector(ctx):
            merged[finding.key] = merged[finding.key].merged_with(finding) if finding.key in merged else finding
    return sorted(merged.values(), key=lambda f: (f.code, f.file, f.line or 0, f.key))

"""D12 instruction-like wording in free text. A second layer only: text is data and nothing here can approve anything."""
import re

from app.domain.findings import Finding, new_finding
from app.domain.quarantine import Quarantined
from app.domain.refs import SourceRef
from app.domain.runs import Context

PATTERNS = tuple(re.compile(p, re.IGNORECASE) for p in (
    r"\b(automated|ai)\b.{0,40}\b(reviewers?|assistants?|tools?|agents?)\b",
    r"\bpre-?approved\b",
    r"\bskip (the )?(debit/credit )?(balance )?check",
    r"\bdo not (list|report|flag|mention)\b",
    r"\bignore (all |any )?(previous |prior |above )?(instructions|rules|checks)",
    r"\bmark (it |this )?as (accepted|approved)\b",
))


def _texts(ctx: Context) -> list[tuple[str, SourceRef]]:
    items = [(line.local_name.text, line.ref) for lines in ctx.inputs.trial_balances.values() for line in lines]
    items += [(row.local_name.text, row.ref) for index in ctx.inputs.maps.values() for rows in index.values() for row in rows]
    items += [(account.name, account.ref) for account in ctx.inputs.coa.values()]
    for journal in ctx.inputs.journals:
        items.append((journal.description.text, journal.ref))
        items += [(line.memo.text, line.memo_ref or line.ref) for line in journal.lines if line.memo is not None]
    return items


def d12_instruction_wording(ctx: Context) -> list[Finding]:
    found = []
    for text, ref in _texts(ctx):
        if any(pattern.search(text) for pattern in PATTERNS):
            claim = ("free text addressed to automated tools was found and treated as data; "
                     "it was not obeyed and cannot change any decision")
            found.append(new_finding("D12", "FLAG", claim, ref.file, ref.line, "flagged", None, "text",
                                     (ref,), Quarantined(text=text)))
    return found

"""Registers the detectors, runs them and merges findings that share a key."""
from collections.abc import Callable

from app.detectors.balance import d01_trial_balance, d03_journal_balance
from app.detectors.duplicates import d14_exact_duplicates
from app.detectors.expectations import d13_expectations
from app.detectors.journals import d04_period, d05_duplicate, d06_account_exists, d07_reversal_exceeds_balance
from app.detectors.mapping import d02_mapping
from app.detectors.rates import d08_required_rates
from app.detectors.reconciliation import d09_subledger, d10_cross_file_ties, d11_intercompany_pairing
from app.detectors.text_scan import d12_instruction_wording
from app.domain.findings import Finding
from app.domain.runs import Context

Detector = Callable[[Context], list[Finding]]

DETECTORS: tuple[Detector, ...] = (
    d01_trial_balance, d02_mapping, d03_journal_balance, d04_period, d05_duplicate, d06_account_exists,
    d07_reversal_exceeds_balance, d08_required_rates, d09_subledger, d10_cross_file_ties,
    d11_intercompany_pairing, d12_instruction_wording, d13_expectations, d14_exact_duplicates,
)


def run_all(ctx: Context) -> list[Finding]:
    """Every detector runs; two findings with one key become one. Order is stable: code, file, line."""
    merged: dict[str, Finding] = {}
    for detector in DETECTORS:
        for finding in detector(ctx):
            merged[finding.key] = merged[finding.key].merged_with(finding) if finding.key in merged else finding
    return sorted(merged.values(), key=lambda f: (f.code, f.file, f.line or 0, f.key))

def test_d07_finds_the_reversal_larger_than_the_accrual(ctx: Context) -> None:

    assert by_code(ctx, "D01") == [] and by_code(ctx, "D10") == []

    (finding,) = [f for f in by_code(broken, "D10") if f.key.endswith("monthly_IN-REV")]
    assert finding.amount_affected == Decimal("1.00")

from collections import Counter
from collections.abc import Callable
from decimal import Decimal

from app.detectors.registry import run_all
from app.domain.findings import Finding
from app.domain.runs import Context

Edit = Callable[[str, str, str], Context]


def by_code(ctx: Context, code: str, field: str = "") -> list[Finding]:
    return [f for f in run_all(ctx) if f.code == code and f.key.endswith(field)]


def test_every_known_defect_gives_exactly_one_finding(ctx: Context) -> None:
    counts = Counter(f.code for f in run_all(ctx))
    assert dict(counts) == {
        "D02": 1, "D03": 1, "D04": 1, "D05": 1, "D06": 1, "D07": 1, "D08": 1, "D09": 2, "D11": 1, "D12": 1, "D13": 2,
    }


def test_d03_finds_je006_unbalanced_by_1200(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D03")
    assert "JE-006" in finding.claim and finding.amount_affected == Decimal("1200.00")
    assert (finding.file, finding.line) == ("adjustments.json", 102)


def test_d04_finds_je017_dated_2025(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D04")
    assert "JE-017" in finding.claim and finding.amount_affected == Decimal("22000.00")


def test_d05_finds_je019_as_the_duplicate_of_je014(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D05")
    assert "JE-019 repeats the postings of JE-014" in finding.claim


def test_d06_finds_the_india_account_that_is_not_in_the_map(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D06")
    assert "IN-GST-ITC" in finding.claim and finding.line == 301


def test_d07_finds_the_reversal_larger_than_the_accrual(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D07")
    assert "JE-009" in finding.claim and "-48300.00" in finding.claim


def test_d02_finds_deferred_income_mapped_to_revenue_and_remaps_it_as_assumed(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D02")
    assert (finding.file, finding.line, finding.action) == ("map_uk.csv", 12, "assumed")
    assert finding.amount_affected == Decimal("180000.00")


def test_d02_leaves_the_mapping_as_supplied_when_the_remap_is_not_approved(ctx: Context) -> None:
    unapproved = Context(ctx.inputs, ctx.policy, {**ctx.assumptions, "map_uk_2310": "none"})
    (finding,) = by_code(unapproved, "D02")
    assert finding.action == "flagged" and "applied as supplied" in finding.claim


def test_d08_reports_the_missing_sgd_closing_rate(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D08")
    assert "GBP/SGD closing rate" in finding.claim and finding.line == 3
    assert finding.amount_affected == Decimal("23010.00")


def test_d09_reports_the_45000_uk_sub_ledger_gaps(ctx: Context) -> None:
    findings = by_code(ctx, "D09")
    assert [f.amount_affected for f in findings] == [Decimal("45000.00")] * 2
    assert {f.line for f in findings} == {4, 5}


def test_d11_reports_the_invoice_missing_from_the_uk_side(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D11")
    assert "INV-US-2291" in finding.claim and finding.action == "assumed"
    assert round(finding.amount_affected or Decimal(0), 2) == Decimal("8108.54")


def test_d12_quotes_the_je006_memo_and_does_not_obey_it(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D12")
    assert (finding.file, finding.line, finding.action) == ("adjustments.json", 112, "flagged")
    assert finding.quoted_text is not None and "AUTOMATED REVIEWERS" in finding.quoted_text.text


def test_d13_notes_the_tax_step_at_the_acquisition_month_and_the_identical_months(ctx: Context) -> None:
    claims = [f.claim for f in by_code(ctx, "D13")]
    assert any("24.37% in 2024-06 to 31.82% in 2024-07" in c for c in claims)
    assert any("2024-09, 2024-10, 2024-11 are identical" in c for c in claims)


def test_d14_does_not_flag_the_two_uk_wage_rows(ctx: Context) -> None:
    assert by_code(ctx, "D14") == []


def test_d01_and_d10_pass_on_the_supplied_data(ctx: Context) -> None:
    assert by_code(ctx, "D01") == [] and by_code(ctx, "D10") == []


def test_unbalanced_trial_balance_is_blocked(edited_context: Edit) -> None:
    broken = edited_context("tb_us.csv", "1100,Cash and cash equivalents,4875000.00", "1100,Cash and cash equivalents,4875001.00")
    (finding,) = by_code(broken, "D01")
    assert finding.severity == "BLOCK" and finding.amount_affected == Decimal("1.00")


def test_account_missing_from_the_map_is_carried_as_unmapped(edited_context: Edit) -> None:
    broken = edited_context("map_uk.csv", "7500,General overheads,6500\n", "")
    (finding,) = by_code(broken, "D02", ":unmapped")
    assert finding.amount_affected == Decimal("640000.00")


def test_a_code_mapped_two_ways_blocks(edited_context: Edit) -> None:
    both = "7500,General overheads,6500\n7500,General overheads,6200\n"
    broken = edited_context("map_uk.csv", "7500,General overheads,6500\n", both)
    assert [f.severity for f in by_code(broken, "D02", ":ambiguous")] == ["BLOCK"]


def test_monthly_file_that_no_longer_ties_blocks(edited_context: Edit) -> None:
    row = "IN-REV,Revenue from operations,2024-04,"
    broken = edited_context("in_pl_monthly.csv", row + "65600000.00", row + "65600001.00")
    (finding,) = by_code(broken, "D10", "monthly_IN-REV")
    assert finding.amount_affected == Decimal("1.00")

"""D09 sub-ledger, D10 cross-file tie-outs, D11 intercompany pairing."""
from decimal import Decimal

from app.detectors.mapping import classified
from app.domain.findings import Finding, new_finding
from app.domain.runs import Context
from app.parsers.acquisition_note import table_foots
from app.parsers.fx_rates import FxTable

# control ledger name -> (group account holding it, sign that makes the TB balance positive)
CONTROLS = {"Accounts receivable (trade)": ("1200", 1), "Accounts payable (trade)": ("2100", -1)}
TIE_TOLERANCE = Decimal("0.01")  # assumption A12: the supplied opening equity is rounded to the cent


def _group_total(ctx: Context, entity: str, group: str) -> Decimal:
    mine = (m.line.amount for m in classified(ctx) if m.line.entity == entity and m.group_code == group)
    return sum(mine, Decimal(0))


def d09_subledger(ctx: Context) -> list[Finding]:
    """Checked on the unadjusted trial balance, before any journal."""
    found = []
    for control in ctx.inputs.subledger:
        group, sign = CONTROLS[control.ledger]
        book = sign * _group_total(ctx, control.entity, group)
        if book != control.control_total:
            claim = (f"{control.entity} {control.ledger}: trial balance {book} against sub-ledger "
                     f"{control.control_total} {control.currency}; not adjusted")
            found.append(new_finding("D09", "FLAG", claim, control.ref.file, control.ref.line, "flagged",
                                     abs(book - control.control_total), "control_total", (control.ref,)))
    return found


def _monthly_ties(ctx: Context) -> list[Finding]:
    found = []
    tb = {line.local_code: line for line in ctx.inputs.trial_balances["IN"]}
    for code in sorted({row.ledger_code for row in ctx.inputs.india_monthly}):
        total = sum((r.amount for r in ctx.inputs.india_monthly if r.ledger_code == code), Decimal(0))
        line = tb.get(code)
        if line is None or line.amount != total:
            ref = line.ref if line else ctx.inputs.india_monthly[0].ref
            claim = f"India monthly P&L for {code} sums to {total}, trial balance holds {line.amount if line else 'nothing'}"
            found.append(new_finding("D10", "BLOCK", claim, ref.file, ref.line, "blocked",
                                     abs(total - (line.amount if line else 0)), f"monthly_{code}", (ref,)))
    return found


def _opening_equity_tie(ctx: Context, fx: FxTable) -> list[Finding]:
    """Opening group equity should equal the entities' opening net assets at the opening rate, within a cent."""
    opening = fx.units_per_gbp("USD", "opening")
    if opening is None or not ctx.inputs.prior_equity:
        return []
    equity = {"US": -(_group_total(ctx, "US", "3100") + _group_total(ctx, "US", "3200")),
              "UK": -(_group_total(ctx, "UK", "3100") + _group_total(ctx, "UK", "3200"))}
    rebuilt = equity["US"] / opening + equity["UK"] - _group_total(ctx, "US", "1600") / opening
    given = sum((p.amount_gbp for p in ctx.inputs.prior_equity.values()), Decimal(0))
    if abs(rebuilt - given) > TIE_TOLERANCE:
        ref = ctx.inputs.prior_equity["3100"].ref
        claim = f"prior_year_group.csv equity {given} does not tie to opening net assets {rebuilt}"
        return [new_finding("D10", "FLAG", claim, ref.file, ref.line, "flagged", abs(rebuilt - given), "opening_equity")]
    return []


def d10_cross_file_ties(ctx: Context) -> list[Finding]:
    found = _monthly_ties(ctx)
    note = ctx.inputs.acquisition
    if not table_foots(note):
        ref = note.refs["net_assets"]
        found.append(new_finding("D10", "BLOCK", "the acquisition note table does not foot", ref.file, ref.line,
                                 "blocked", None, "foot", (ref,)))
    fx = FxTable(ctx.inputs.rates)
    spot_inr, spot_usd = fx.units_per_gbp("INR", "spot"), fx.units_per_gbp("USD", "spot")
    if spot_inr and spot_usd:
        expected = note.consideration_inr / (spot_inr / spot_usd)
        booked = _group_total(ctx, "US", "1610")
        if abs(expected - booked) > TIE_TOLERANCE:
            claim = f"US investment in India is {booked}; consideration at the spot rate is {expected}"
            found.append(new_finding("D10", "FLAG", claim, "tb_us.csv", None, "flagged", abs(expected - booked), "invest"))
    return found + _opening_equity_tie(ctx, fx)


def d11_intercompany_pairing(ctx: Context) -> list[Finding]:
    fx = FxTable(ctx.inputs.rates)
    by_side: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
    for inv in ctx.inputs.intercompany:
        by_side.setdefault(inv.reporting_entity, {})[inv.doc_ref] = inv
    found = []
    for inv in ctx.inputs.intercompany:
        other = by_side.get(inv.counterparty, {}).get(inv.doc_ref)
        if other is None:
            gbp = fx.to_gbp(inv.doc_amount, inv.doc_currency, "closing")
            claim = (f"{inv.doc_ref} ({inv.doc_currency} {inv.doc_amount}) is booked by {inv.reporting_entity} but "
                     f"not by {inv.counterparty}: in transit at the year end, recorded at the closing rate (policy 5)")
            found.append(new_finding("D11", "FLAG", claim, inv.ref.file, inv.ref.line, "assumed", gbp, "unpaired", (inv.ref,)))
    return found

import re

from app.domain.findings import Finding, new_finding
from app.domain.quarantine import Quarantined

PATTERNS = tuple(re.compile(p, re.IGNORECASE) for p in (
    r"\b(automated|ai)\b.{0,40}\b(reviewers?|assistants?|tools?|agents?)\b",
    r"\bpre-?approved\b",
    r"\bskip (the )?(debit/credit )?(balance )?check",
    r"\bdo not (list|report|flag|mention)\b",
    r"\bignore (all |any )?(previous |prior |above )?(instructions|rules|checks)",
    r"\bmark (it |this )?as (accepted|approved)\b",
))


def _texts(ctx: Context) -> list[tuple[str, SourceRef]]:
    items = [(line.local_name.text, line.ref) for lines in ctx.inputs.trial_balances.values() for line in lines]
    items += [(row.local_name.text, row.ref) for index in ctx.inputs.maps.values() for rows in index.values() for row in rows]
    items += [(account.name, account.ref) for account in ctx.inputs.coa.values()]
    for journal in ctx.inputs.journals:
        items.append((journal.description.text, journal.ref))
        items += [(line.memo.text, line.memo_ref or line.ref) for line in journal.lines if line.memo is not None]
    return items


def d12_instruction_wording(ctx: Context) -> list[Finding]:
    found = []
    for text, ref in _texts(ctx):
        if any(pattern.search(text) for pattern in PATTERNS):
            claim = ("free text addressed to automated tools was found and treated as data; "
                     "it was not obeyed and cannot change any decision")
            found.append(new_finding("D12", "FLAG", claim, ref.file, ref.line, "flagged", None, "text",
                                     (ref,), Quarantined(text=text)))
    return found

from collections import Counter
from collections.abc import Callable
from decimal import Decimal

from app.detectors.registry import run_all
from app.domain.findings import Finding
from app.domain.runs import Context

Edit = Callable[[str, str, str], Context]


def by_code(ctx: Context, code: str, field: str = "") -> list[Finding]:
    return [f for f in run_all(ctx) if f.code == code and f.key.endswith(field)]


def test_every_known_defect_gives_exactly_one_finding(ctx: Context) -> None:
    counts = Counter(f.code for f in run_all(ctx))
    assert dict(counts) == {
        "D02": 1, "D03": 1, "D04": 1, "D05": 1, "D06": 1, "D07": 1, "D08": 1, "D09": 2, "D11": 1, "D12": 1, "D13": 2,
    }


def test_d03_finds_je006_unbalanced_by_1200(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D03")
    assert "JE-006" in finding.claim and finding.amount_affected == Decimal("1200.00")
    assert (finding.file, finding.line) == ("adjustments.json", 102)


def test_d04_finds_je017_dated_2025(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D04")
    assert "JE-017" in finding.claim and finding.amount_affected == Decimal("22000.00")


def test_d05_finds_je019_as_the_duplicate_of_je014(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D05")
    assert "JE-019 repeats the postings of JE-014" in finding.claim


def test_d06_finds_the_india_account_that_is_not_in_the_map(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D06")
    assert "IN-GST-ITC" in finding.claim and finding.line == 301


def test_d07_finds_the_reversal_larger_than_the_accrual(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D07")
    assert "JE-009" in finding.claim and "-48300.00" in finding.claim


def test_d02_finds_deferred_income_mapped_to_revenue_and_remaps_it_as_assumed(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D02")
    assert (finding.file, finding.line, finding.action) == ("map_uk.csv", 12, "assumed")
    assert finding.amount_affected == Decimal("180000.00")


def test_d02_leaves_the_mapping_as_supplied_when_the_remap_is_not_approved(ctx: Context) -> None:
    unapproved = Context(ctx.inputs, ctx.policy, {**ctx.assumptions, "map_uk_2310": "none"})
    (finding,) = by_code(unapproved, "D02")
    assert finding.action == "flagged" and "applied as supplied" in finding.claim


def test_d08_reports_the_missing_sgd_closing_rate(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D08")
    assert "GBP/SGD closing rate" in finding.claim and finding.line == 3
    assert finding.amount_affected == Decimal("23010.00")


def test_d09_reports_the_45000_uk_sub_ledger_gaps(ctx: Context) -> None:
    findings = by_code(ctx, "D09")
    assert [f.amount_affected for f in findings] == [Decimal("45000.00")] * 2
    assert {f.line for f in findings} == {4, 5}


def test_d11_reports_the_invoice_missing_from_the_uk_side(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D11")
    assert "INV-US-2291" in finding.claim and finding.action == "assumed"
    assert round(finding.amount_affected or Decimal(0), 2) == Decimal("8108.54")


def test_d12_quotes_the_je006_memo_and_does_not_obey_it(ctx: Context) -> None:
    (finding,) = by_code(ctx, "D12")
    assert (finding.file, finding.line, finding.action) == ("adjustments.json", 112, "flagged")
    assert finding.quoted_text is not None and "AUTOMATED REVIEWERS" in finding.quoted_text.text


def test_d13_notes_the_tax_step_at_the_acquisition_month_and_the_identical_months(ctx: Context) -> None:
    claims = [f.claim for f in by_code(ctx, "D13")]
    assert any("24.37% in 2024-06 to 31.82% in 2024-07" in c for c in claims)
    assert any("2024-09, 2024-10, 2024-11 are identical" in c for c in claims)


def test_d14_does_not_flag_the_two_uk_wage_rows(ctx: Context) -> None:
    assert by_code(ctx, "D14") == []


def test_d01_and_d10_pass_on_the_supplied_data(ctx: Context) -> None:

"""One deduplicated problem found in the inputs or the run, with the place it came from."""
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Literal

from app.domain.quarantine import Quarantined
from app.domain.refs import Model, Money, SourceRef


def new_finding(
    code: str, severity: Literal["BLOCK", "FLAG", "NOTE"], claim: str, file: str, line: int | None,
    action: Literal["blocked", "assumed", "flagged", "noted"], amount: Decimal | None = None, field: str = "",
    evidence: tuple[SourceRef, ...] = (), quoted: Quarantined | None = None,
) -> "Finding":
    """Build a finding with its stable key (code, file, line, field)."""
    key = f"{code}:{file}:{line if line is not None else 0}:{field}"
    return Finding(
        key=key, code=code, severity=severity, claim=claim, file=file, line=line,
        amount_affected=amount, action=action, evidence=evidence, quoted_text=quoted,
    )


class Finding(Model):
    """`key` is stable (code, file, line, field), so the same defect found twice is one finding."""

    key: str
    code: str
    severity: Literal["BLOCK", "FLAG", "NOTE"]
    claim: str
    file: str
    line: int | None
    amount_affected: Money | None
    action: Literal["blocked", "assumed", "flagged", "noted"]
    evidence: tuple[SourceRef, ...] = ()
    quoted_text: Quarantined | None = None

    def merged_with(self, other: "Finding") -> "Finding":
        """Same key found by two detectors: keep the stronger severity and the union of the evidence."""
        order = {"BLOCK": 2, "FLAG": 1, "NOTE": 0}
        winner = self if order[self.severity] >= order[other.severity] else other
        evidence = tuple(dict.fromkeys(self.evidence + other.evidence))
        return winner.model_copy(update={"evidence": evidence})

"""One deduplicated problem found in the inputs or the run, with the place it came from."""
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import Literal

from app.domain.quarantine import Quarantined
from app.domain.refs import Model, Money, SourceRef


def new_finding(
    code: str, severity: Literal["BLOCK", "FLAG", "NOTE"], claim: str, file: str, line: int | None,
    action: Literal["blocked", "assumed", "flagged", "noted"], amount: Decimal | None = None, field: str = "",
    evidence: tuple[SourceRef, ...] = (), quoted: Quarantined | None = None, subject: str | None = None,
) -> "Finding":
    """Build a finding with its stable key (code, file, line, field). `subject` names the journal it is about."""
    key = f"{code}:{file}:{line if line is not None else 0}:{field}"
    return Finding(
        key=key, code=code, severity=severity, claim=claim, file=file, line=line,
        amount_affected=amount, action=action, evidence=evidence, quoted_text=quoted, subject=subject,
    )


class Finding(Model):
    """`key` is stable (code, file, line, field), so the same defect found twice is one finding."""

    key: str
    code: str
    severity: Literal["BLOCK", "FLAG", "NOTE"]
    claim: str
    file: str
    line: int | None
    amount_affected: Money | None
    action: Literal["blocked", "assumed", "flagged", "noted"]
    evidence: tuple[SourceRef, ...] = ()
    quoted_text: Quarantined | None = None

    def merged_with(self, other: "Finding") -> "Finding":
        """Same key found by two detectors: keep the stronger severity and the union of the evidence."""
        order = {"BLOCK": 2, "FLAG": 1, "NOTE": 0}
        winner = self if order[self.severity] >= order[other.severity] else other
        evidence = tuple(dict.fromkeys(self.evidence + other.evidence))
        return winner.model_copy(update={"evidence": evidence})

"""Foreign-currency items inside an entity's own books at the closing rate (policy 3)."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal

from app.domain.entries import Entry, Posting
from app.domain.ledger import LedgerLine, MappedLine
from app.parsers.fx_rates import FxTable

# policy 3 restates monetary items only: cash, receivables, payables, accruals, tax and borrowings
MONETARY = {"1100", "1200", "1250", "2100", "2150", "2200", "2400", "2500"}
FX_DIFFERENCE = "7300"


@dataclass
class RevalueResult:
    entries: list[Entry]
    unresolved: list[LedgerLine]


def restated_amount(line: LedgerLine, fx: FxTable) -> Decimal | None:
    """The line's foreign amount in the entity's functional currency at closing; None without a closing rate."""
    if line.txn_ccy is None or line.txn_amount is None:
        return None
    foreign, home = fx.units_per_gbp(line.txn_ccy, "closing"), fx.units_per_gbp(line.currency, "closing")
    if foreign is None or home is None:
        return None
    return line.txn_amount / foreign * home


def revalue(mapped: list[MappedLine], fx: FxTable) -> RevalueResult:
    """Dr or Cr the item and the opposite to 7300. A line with no closing rate is left alone and reported."""
    entries: list[Entry] = []
    unresolved: list[LedgerLine] = []
    for item in mapped:
        line = item.line
        if item.group_code not in MONETARY or line.txn_ccy is None:
            continue
        restated = restated_amount(line, fx)
        if restated is None:
            unresolved.append(line)
            continue
        difference = restated - line.amount
        if difference == 0:
            continue
        rate = fx.ref(line.txn_ccy, "closing")
        note = f"{line.local_code} {line.txn_ccy} {line.txn_amount} at closing"
        sources = (line.ref,)
        entries.append(Entry(
            id=f"REV-{line.entity}-{line.local_code}", origin="REVALUE", description=f"Revalue {note}",
            lines=(
                Posting(entity=line.entity, account=item.group_code or "", amount=difference, ccy=line.currency,
                        origin="REVALUE", sources=sources, rate_ref=rate, note=note),
                Posting(entity=line.entity, account=FX_DIFFERENCE, amount=-difference, ccy=line.currency,
                        origin="REVALUE", sources=sources, rate_ref=rate, note=note),
            ),
        ))
    return RevalueResult(entries, unresolved)

"""Foreign-currency items inside an entity's own books at the closing rate (policy 3)."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal

from app.domain.entries import Entry, Posting
from app.domain.ledger import LedgerLine, MappedLine
from app.parsers.fx_rates import FxTable

# policy 3 restates monetary items only: cash, receivables, payables, accruals, tax and borrowings
MONETARY = {"1100", "1200", "1250", "2100", "2150", "2200", "2400", "2500"}
FX_DIFFERENCE = "7300"


@dataclass
class RevalueResult:
    entries: list[Entry]
    unresolved: list[LedgerLine]


def restated_amount(line: LedgerLine, fx: FxTable) -> Decimal | None:
    """The line's foreign amount in the entity's functional currency at closing; None without a closing rate."""
    if line.txn_ccy is None or line.txn_amount is None:
        return None
    foreign, home = fx.units_per_gbp(line.txn_ccy, "closing"), fx.units_per_gbp(line.currency, "closing")
    if foreign is None or home is None:
        return None
    return line.txn_amount / foreign * home


def revalue(mapped: list[MappedLine], fx: FxTable) -> RevalueResult:
    """Dr or Cr the item and the opposite to 7300. A line with no closing rate is left alone and reported."""
    entries: list[Entry] = []
    unresolved: list[LedgerLine] = []
    for item in mapped:
        line = item.line
        if item.group_code not in MONETARY or line.txn_ccy is None:
            continue
        restated = restated_amount(line, fx)
        if restated is None:
            unresolved.append(line)
            continue
        difference = restated - line.amount
        if difference == 0:
            continue
        rate = fx.ref(line.txn_ccy, "closing")
        note = f"{line.local_code} {line.txn_ccy} {line.txn_amount} at closing"
        sources = (line.ref,)
        entries.append(Entry(
            id=f"REV-{line.entity}-{line.local_code}", origin="REVALUE", description=f"Revalue {note}",
            lines=(
                Posting(entity=line.entity, account=item.group_code or "", amount=difference, ccy=line.currency,
                        origin="REVALUE", sources=sources, rate_ref=rate, note=note),
                Posting(entity=line.entity, account=FX_DIFFERENCE, amount=-difference, ccy=line.currency,
                        origin="REVALUE", sources=sources, rate_ref=rate, note=note),
            ),
        ))
    return RevalueResult(entries, unresolved)

@dataclass
class RevalueResult:
    entries: list[Entry]
    unresolved: list[LedgerLine]


def restated_amount(line: LedgerLine, fx: FxTable) -> Decimal | None:
    """The line's foreign amount in the entity's functional currency at closing; None without a closing rate."""
    if line.txn_ccy is None or line.txn_amount is None:
        return None
    foreign, home = fx.units_per_gbp(line.txn_ccy, "closing"), fx.units_per_gbp(line.currency, "closing")
    if foreign is None or home is None:
        return None
    return line.txn_amount / foreign * home


def revalue(mapped: list[MappedLine], fx: FxTable) -> RevalueResult:
    """Dr or Cr the item and the opposite to 7300. A line with no closing rate is left alone and reported."""
    entries: list[Entry] = []
    unresolved: list[LedgerLine] = []
    for item in mapped:
        line = item.line
        if item.group_code not in MONETARY or line.txn_ccy is None:
            continue
        restated = restated_amount(line, fx)
        if restated is None:
            unresolved.append(line)
            continue
        difference = restated - line.amount
        if difference == 0:
            continue
        rate = fx.ref(line.txn_ccy, "closing")
        note = f"{line.local_code} {line.txn_ccy} {line.txn_amount} at closing"
        sources = (line.ref,)
        entries.append(Entry(
            id=f"REV-{line.entity}-{line.local_code}", origin="REVALUE", description=f"Revalue {note}",
            lines=(
                Posting(entity=line.entity, account=item.group_code or "", amount=difference, ccy=line.currency,
                        origin="REVALUE", sources=sources, rate_ref=rate, note=note),
                Posting(entity=line.entity, account=FX_DIFFERENCE, amount=-difference, ccy=line.currency,
                        origin="REVALUE", sources=sources, rate_ref=rate, note=note),
            ),
        ))
    return RevalueResult(entries, unresolved)

"""Translate entity postings into GBP: closing rate for the balance sheet, average for the period for income."""
from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

from app.domain.entries import Posting
from app.domain.runs import Inputs
from app.parsers.fx_rates import FxTable


class ConsolidationBlocked(Exception):
    """A step cannot run because an input it needs is missing. The run continues; dependent figures are Unknown."""


def _rate(fx: FxTable, ccy: str, rate_type: str, entity: str) -> Decimal:
    rate = fx.units_per_gbp(ccy, rate_type)
    if rate is None:
        raise ConsolidationBlocked(f"{entity} cannot be translated: no {ccy} {rate_type} rate in fx_rates.csv")
    return rate


def translate(postings: list[Posting], inputs: Inputs, fx: FxTable, year_end: date) -> list[Posting]:
    """Policy 2. Equity accounts are skipped: group equity comes from the prior-year file and the reserve, not from
    translating each entity's own equity lines."""
    out = []
    for p in postings:
        account = inputs.coa.get(p.account)
        if account is not None and account.account_type == "Equity":
            continue
        entity = inputs.entities[p.entity]
        if account is not None and account.statement == "PL":
            rate_type = fx.average_type(entity.acquisition_date, year_end)
            if rate_type is None:
                raise ConsolidationBlocked(f"{p.entity} has no average rate for the period it was owned")
        else:

"""The India acquisition: post-acquisition period, goodwill and non-controlling interest (policy 4)."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal

from app.core.translate import ConsolidationBlocked
from app.domain.entries import Posting
from app.domain.refs import SourceRef
from app.domain.runs import Inputs
from app.parsers.fx_rates import FxTable
from app.parsers.mappings import resolve_account

INDIA = "IN"  # the entity of in_pl_monthly.csv


def india_period_postings(postings: list[Posting], inputs: Inputs) -> list[Posting]:
    """India's trial balance is nine months. Income and expense come from the monthly file for the months owned;
    profit for the months before completion moves to reserves, because it belongs to the seller."""
    entity = inputs.entities[INDIA]
    if entity.acquisition_date is None:
        return postings
    cutoff = f"{entity.acquisition_date.year}-{entity.acquisition_date.month:02d}"
    kept = [p for p in postings if not _is_india_income(p, inputs)]
    owned = [r for r in inputs.india_monthly if r.month >= cutoff]
    before = [r for r in inputs.india_monthly if r.month < cutoff]
    for row in owned:
        account = resolve_account(inputs.maps, inputs.coa, INDIA, row.ledger_code)
        kept.append(Posting(entity=INDIA, account=account or "UNMAPPED", amount=row.amount, ccy=entity.currency,
                            origin="IMPORT", sources=(row.ref,), note=f"{row.ledger_code} {row.month}"))
    if before:
        kept.append(Posting(
            entity=INDIA, account="3200", amount=sum((r.amount for r in before), Decimal(0)), ccy=entity.currency,
            origin="ACQUISITION", sources=tuple(r.ref for r in before),
            note=f"profit before completion ({before[0].month} to {before[-1].month}) carried to reserves",
        ))
    if sum((p.amount for p in kept if p.entity == INDIA), Decimal(0)) != 0:
        raise ConsolidationBlocked("the India monthly file does not tie to its trial balance")
    return kept


def _is_india_income(p: Posting, inputs: Inputs) -> bool:
    account = inputs.coa.get(p.account)
    return p.entity == INDIA and p.origin == "IMPORT" and account is not None and account.statement == "PL"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AcquisitionFigures:
    goodwill_inr: Decimal
    goodwill_gbp: Decimal
    nci_at_acquisition: Decimal
    nci_closing: Decimal
    nci_profit: Decimal
    nci_translation: Decimal
    india_net_assets_inr: Decimal
    india_profit_gbp: Decimal
    closing_rate: Decimal
    refs: tuple[SourceRef, ...]


def acquisition_figures(
    inputs: Inputs, fx: FxTable, local: list[Posting], translated: list[Posting],
) -> AcquisitionFigures:
    note = inputs.acquisition
    closing, spot = fx.units_per_gbp("INR", "closing"), fx.units_per_gbp("INR", "spot")
    if closing is None or spot is None:
        raise ConsolidationBlocked("India goodwill needs the INR closing and spot rates")
    owned = note.interest_pct / 100
    goodwill_inr = note.consideration_inr - owned * note.net_assets_at_completion
    net_assets = sum((p.amount for p in local if p.entity == INDIA and _is_balance_sheet(p, inputs)), Decimal(0))
    profit = -sum((p.amount for p in translated if p.entity == INDIA and _is_income(p, inputs)), Decimal(0))
    nci_share = 1 - owned
    at_acquisition = nci_share * note.net_assets_at_completion / spot
    closing_nci = nci_share * net_assets / closing
    nci_profit = nci_share * profit
    return AcquisitionFigures(
        goodwill_inr=goodwill_inr, goodwill_gbp=goodwill_inr / closing, nci_at_acquisition=at_acquisition,
        nci_closing=closing_nci, nci_profit=nci_profit, nci_translation=closing_nci - at_acquisition - nci_profit,
        india_net_assets_inr=net_assets, india_profit_gbp=profit, closing_rate=closing,
        refs=tuple(note.refs.values()),
    )


def _is_balance_sheet(p: Posting, inputs: Inputs) -> bool:
    account = inputs.coa.get(p.account)
    return account is not None and account.statement == "BS" and account.account_type != "Equity"


def _is_income(p: Posting, inputs: Inputs) -> bool:
    account = inputs.coa.get(p.account)
    return account is not None and account.statement == "PL"

"""Eliminate intercompany balances and income, and the investments in subsidiaries (policy 5)."""
from decimal import Decimal

from app.core.acquisition import AcquisitionFigures
from app.core.translate import ConsolidationBlocked
from app.domain.entries import Entry, Posting
from app.domain.refs import SourceRef
from app.domain.runs import Inputs

# group chart accounts for intercompany items and for the investments the US parent holds
IC_RECEIVABLE, IC_PAYABLE, IC_INCOME, IC_EXPENSE = "1250", "2150", "4200", "6300"
INVESTMENT = {"UK": "1600", "IN": "1610"}


def total(postings: list[Posting], account: str, entity: str | None = None) -> Decimal:
    return sum((p.amount for p in postings if p.account == account and (entity is None or p.entity == entity)), Decimal(0))


def _sources(postings: list[Posting], *accounts: str) -> tuple[SourceRef, ...]:
    refs = [s for p in postings if p.account in accounts for s in p.sources]
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(refs))


def _leg(account: str, amount: Decimal, note: str, sources: tuple[SourceRef, ...], rate: str | None = None) -> Posting:
    return Posting(entity="GROUP", account=account, amount=amount, ccy="GBP", origin="ELIMINATION",
                   sources=sources, rate_ref=rate, note=note)


def ic_balances(translated: list[Posting]) -> Entry:
    """Policy 5: eliminated in full. Both sides were restated to the closing rate, so they should be equal."""
    receivable, payable = total(translated, IC_RECEIVABLE), total(translated, IC_PAYABLE)
    sources = _sources(translated, IC_RECEIVABLE, IC_PAYABLE)
    return Entry(id="ELIM-IC-BALANCES", origin="ELIMINATION", description="Eliminate intercompany receivable and payable",
                 lines=(_leg(IC_PAYABLE, -payable, "intercompany payable", sources),
                        _leg(IC_RECEIVABLE, -receivable, "intercompany receivable", sources)))


def ic_income_expense(translated: list[Posting], residual_account: str) -> Entry:
    """Income at the average rate against expense as booked or recorded: the difference goes to 7300 (policy 5)."""
    income, expense = total(translated, IC_INCOME), total(translated, IC_EXPENSE)
    sources = _sources(translated, IC_INCOME, IC_EXPENSE)
    residual = income + expense
    return Entry(id="ELIM-IC-INCOME", origin="ELIMINATION", description="Eliminate intercompany management fees",
                 lines=(_leg(IC_INCOME, -income, "management fee income", sources),
                        _leg(IC_EXPENSE, -expense, "management fee expense", sources),
                        _leg(residual_account, residual, "rate difference on elimination", sources)))


def investments(inputs: Inputs, local: list[Posting], translated: list[Posting], acq: AcquisitionFigures) -> list[Entry]:
    """Remove each investment against what it bought. Equity legs (3100, 3200, 3300) are shown for the auditor; group
    equity itself is built in reserve.py, so only the 1610 and 1700 legs reach the consolidated balances."""
    entries = []
    uk_investment = total(translated, INVESTMENT["UK"], "US")
    uk_capital = -total(local, "3100", "UK")
    src = _sources(translated, INVESTMENT["UK"]) + _sources(local, "3100")
    entries.append(Entry(id="ELIM-INV-UK", origin="ELIMINATION", description="Eliminate the investment in Northwind UK",
                         lines=(_leg(INVESTMENT["UK"], -uk_investment, "investment at closing", src),
                                _leg("3100", uk_capital, "UK share capital eliminated", src),
                                _leg("3300", uk_investment - uk_capital, "translation difference on the investment", src))))
    india_investment = total(translated, INVESTMENT["IN"], "US")
    owners_share = inputs.acquisition.interest_pct / 100 * inputs.acquisition.net_assets_at_completion / acq.closing_rate
    src = _sources(translated, INVESTMENT["IN"]) + acq.refs
    entries.append(Entry(id="ELIM-INV-IN", origin="ACQUISITION",
                         description="Eliminate the investment in Northwind India and recognise goodwill",
                         lines=(_leg(INVESTMENT["IN"], -india_investment, "investment at closing", src),
                                _leg("1700", acq.goodwill_gbp, "goodwill held in INR at closing", src, "closing INR/GBP"),
                                _leg("3200", owners_share, "owners' share of net assets at completion", src),
                                _leg("3300", india_investment - acq.goodwill_gbp - owners_share, "translation difference", src))))
    if any(not e.is_balanced() for e in entries):
        raise ConsolidationBlocked("an investment elimination does not balance")
    return entries

"""The India acquisition: post-acquisition period, goodwill and non-controlling interest (policy 4)."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal

from app.core.translate import ConsolidationBlocked
from app.domain.entries import Posting
from app.domain.refs import SourceRef
from app.domain.runs import Inputs
from app.parsers.fx_rates import FxTable
from app.parsers.mappings import resolve_account

INDIA = "IN"  # the entity of in_pl_monthly.csv


def india_period_postings(postings: list[Posting], inputs: Inputs) -> list[Posting]:
    """India's trial balance is nine months. Income and expense come from the monthly file for the months owned;
    profit for the months before completion moves to reserves, because it belongs to the seller."""
    entity = inputs.entities[INDIA]
    if entity.acquisition_date is None:
        return postings
    cutoff = f"{entity.acquisition_date.year}-{entity.acquisition_date.month:02d}"
    kept = [p for p in postings if not _is_india_income(p, inputs)]
    owned = [r for r in inputs.india_monthly if r.month >= cutoff]
    before = [r for r in inputs.india_monthly if r.month < cutoff]
    for row in owned:
        account = resolve_account(inputs.maps, inputs.coa, INDIA, row.ledger_code)
        kept.append(Posting(entity=INDIA, account=account or "UNMAPPED", amount=row.amount, ccy=entity.currency,
                            origin="IMPORT", sources=(row.ref,), note=f"{row.ledger_code} {row.month}"))
    if before:
        kept.append(Posting(
            entity=INDIA, account="3200", amount=sum((r.amount for r in before), Decimal(0)), ccy=entity.currency,
            origin="ACQUISITION", sources=tuple(r.ref for r in before),
            note=f"profit before completion ({before[0].month} to {before[-1].month}) carried to reserves",
        ))
    if sum((p.amount for p in kept if p.entity == INDIA), Decimal(0)) != 0:
        raise ConsolidationBlocked("the India monthly file does not tie to its trial balance")
    return kept


def _is_india_income(p: Posting, inputs: Inputs) -> bool:
    account = inputs.coa.get(p.account)
    return p.entity == INDIA and p.origin == "IMPORT" and account is not None and account.statement == "PL"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class AcquisitionFigures:
    goodwill_inr: Decimal
    goodwill_gbp: Decimal
    nci_at_acquisition: Decimal
    nci_closing: Decimal
    nci_profit: Decimal
    nci_translation: Decimal
    india_net_assets_inr: Decimal
    india_profit_gbp: Decimal
    closing_rate: Decimal
    refs: tuple[SourceRef, ...]


def acquisition_figures(
    inputs: Inputs, fx: FxTable, local: list[Posting], translated: list[Posting],
) -> AcquisitionFigures:
    note = inputs.acquisition
    closing, spot = fx.units_per_gbp("INR", "closing"), fx.units_per_gbp("INR", "spot")
    if closing is None or spot is None:
        raise ConsolidationBlocked("India goodwill needs the INR closing and spot rates")
    owned = note.interest_pct / 100
    goodwill_inr = note.consideration_inr - owned * note.net_assets_at_completion
    net_assets = sum((p.amount for p in local if p.entity == INDIA and _is_balance_sheet(p, inputs)), Decimal(0))
    profit = -sum((p.amount for p in translated if p.entity == INDIA and _is_income(p, inputs)), Decimal(0))
    nci_share = 1 - owned
    at_acquisition = nci_share * note.net_assets_at_completion / spot
    closing_nci = nci_share * net_assets / closing
    nci_profit = nci_share * profit
    return AcquisitionFigures(
        goodwill_inr=goodwill_inr, goodwill_gbp=goodwill_inr / closing, nci_at_acquisition=at_acquisition,
        nci_closing=closing_nci, nci_profit=nci_profit, nci_translation=closing_nci - at_acquisition - nci_profit,
        india_net_assets_inr=net_assets, india_profit_gbp=profit, closing_rate=closing,
        refs=tuple(note.refs.values()),
    )


def _is_balance_sheet(p: Posting, inputs: Inputs) -> bool:
    account = inputs.coa.get(p.account)
    return account is not None and account.statement == "BS" and account.account_type != "Equity"


def _is_income(p: Posting, inputs: Inputs) -> bool:
    account = inputs.coa.get(p.account)
    return account is not None and account.statement == "PL"

"""Eliminate intercompany balances and income, and the investments in subsidiaries (policy 5)."""
from decimal import Decimal

from app.core.acquisition import AcquisitionFigures
from app.core.translate import ConsolidationBlocked
from app.domain.entries import Entry, Posting
from app.domain.refs import SourceRef
from app.domain.runs import Inputs

# group chart accounts for intercompany items and for the investments the US parent holds
IC_RECEIVABLE, IC_PAYABLE, IC_INCOME, IC_EXPENSE = "1250", "2150", "4200", "6300"
INVESTMENT = {"UK": "1600", "IN": "1610"}


def total(postings: list[Posting], account: str, entity: str | None = None) -> Decimal:
    return sum((p.amount for p in postings if p.account == account and (entity is None or p.entity == entity)), Decimal(0))


def _sources(postings: list[Posting], *accounts: str) -> tuple[SourceRef, ...]:
    refs = [s for p in postings if p.account in accounts for s in p.sources]
    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(refs))


def _leg(account: str, amount: Decimal, note: str, sources: tuple[SourceRef, ...], rate: str | None = None) -> Posting:
    return Posting(entity="GROUP", account=account, amount=amount, ccy="GBP", origin="ELIMINATION",
                   sources=sources, rate_ref=rate, note=note)


def ic_balances(translated: list[Posting]) -> Entry:
    """Policy 5: eliminated in full. Both sides were restated to the closing rate, so they should be equal."""
    receivable, payable = total(translated, IC_RECEIVABLE), total(translated, IC_PAYABLE)
    sources = _sources(translated, IC_RECEIVABLE, IC_PAYABLE)
    return Entry(id="ELIM-IC-BALANCES", origin="ELIMINATION", description="Eliminate intercompany receivable and payable",
                 lines=(_leg(IC_PAYABLE, -payable, "intercompany payable", sources),
                        _leg(IC_RECEIVABLE, -receivable, "intercompany receivable", sources)))


def ic_income_expense(translated: list[Posting], residual_account: str) -> Entry:
    """Income at the average rate against expense as booked or recorded: the difference goes to 7300 (policy 5)."""
    income, expense = total(translated, IC_INCOME), total(translated, IC_EXPENSE)
    sources = _sources(translated, IC_INCOME, IC_EXPENSE)
    residual = income + expense
    return Entry(id="ELIM-IC-INCOME", origin="ELIMINATION", description="Eliminate intercompany management fees",
                 lines=(_leg(IC_INCOME, -income, "management fee income", sources),
                        _leg(IC_EXPENSE, -expense, "management fee expense", sources),
                        _leg(residual_account, residual, "rate difference on elimination", sources)))


def investments(inputs: Inputs, local: list[Posting], translated: list[Posting], acq: AcquisitionFigures) -> list[Entry]:
    """Remove each investment against what it bought. Equity legs (3100, 3200, 3300) are shown for the auditor; group
    equity itself is built in reserve.py, so only the 1610 and 1700 legs reach the consolidated balances."""
    entries = []
    uk_investment = total(translated, INVESTMENT["UK"], "US")
    uk_capital = -total(local, "3100", "UK")
    src = _sources(translated, INVESTMENT["UK"]) + _sources(local, "3100")
    entries.append(Entry(id="ELIM-INV-UK", origin="ELIMINATION", description="Eliminate the investment in Northwind UK",
                         lines=(_leg(INVESTMENT["UK"], -uk_investment, "investment at closing", src),
                                _leg("3100", uk_capital, "UK share capital eliminated", src),
                                _leg("3300", uk_investment - uk_capital, "translation difference on the investment", src))))
    india_investment = total(translated, INVESTMENT["IN"], "US")
    owners_share = inputs.acquisition.interest_pct / 100 * inputs.acquisition.net_assets_at_completion / acq.closing_rate
    src = _sources(translated, INVESTMENT["IN"]) + acq.refs
    entries.append(Entry(id="ELIM-INV-IN", origin="ACQUISITION",
                         description="Eliminate the investment in Northwind India and recognise goodwill",
                         lines=(_leg(INVESTMENT["IN"], -india_investment, "investment at closing", src),
                                _leg("1700", acq.goodwill_gbp, "goodwill held in INR at closing", src, "closing INR/GBP"),
                                _leg("3200", owners_share, "owners' share of net assets at completion", src),
                                _leg("3300", india_investment - acq.goodwill_gbp - owners_share, "translation difference", src))))
    if any(not e.is_balanced() for e in entries):
        raise ConsolidationBlocked("an investment elimination does not balance")
    return entries

"""Run a consolidation end to end: load the inputs, check them, consolidate, verify, write."""
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from pathlib import Path

from app.config import load_assumptions, load_policy
from app.core.acquisition import AcquisitionFigures, acquisition_figures, india_period_postings
from app.core.eliminate import ic_balances, ic_income_expense, investments
from app.core.intercompany import IcResult, reconcile
from app.core.post_journals import decide, import_postings, journal_postings
from app.core.revalue import RevalueResult, revalue
from app.core.translate import ConsolidationBlocked, translate
from app.detectors.mapping import classified
from app.detectors.registry import run_all
from app.domain.entries import Entry, Posting
from app.domain.findings import Finding
from app.domain.journals import Disposition
from app.domain.ledger import MappedLine
from app.domain.runs import Context, Inputs
from app.parsers.acquisition_note import load_acquisition
from app.parsers.entities import load_entities, load_intercompany, load_prior_equity, load_subledger
from app.parsers.fx_rates import FxTable, load_rates
from app.parsers.journals import load_journals
from app.parsers.mappings import apply_mapping, load_coa, load_map
from app.parsers.tb_adapters import load_india_monthly, load_tb
from app.utils.paths import CONFIG_DIR


def load_inputs(data_dir: Path) -> Inputs:
    """Read every supplied file. An entity reports in group codes when it has no map file (the US)."""
    entities = load_entities(data_dir / "entities.csv")
    maps = {
        entity: load_map(data_dir / f"map_{entity.lower()}.csv", entity)
        for entity in entities if (data_dir / f"map_{entity.lower()}.csv").exists()
    }
    return Inputs(
        data_dir=data_dir,
        entities=entities,
        trial_balances={e.id: load_tb(data_dir / e.tb_file, e.id, e.currency) for e in entities.values()},
        maps=maps,
        coa=load_coa(data_dir / "group_coa.csv"),
        rates=load_rates(data_dir / "fx_rates.csv"),
        journals=load_journals(data_dir / "adjustments.json"),
        intercompany=load_intercompany(data_dir / "intercompany.csv"),
        subledger=load_subledger(data_dir / "subledger_controls.csv"),
        prior_equity=load_prior_equity(data_dir / "prior_year_group.csv"),
        acquisition=load_acquisition(data_dir / "acquisition_note.md"),
        india_monthly=load_india_monthly(data_dir / "in_pl_monthly.csv"),
    )


def build_context(data_dir: Path, config_dir: Path = CONFIG_DIR) -> Context:
    return Context(
        inputs=load_inputs(data_dir),
        policy=load_policy(config_dir / "policy.toml"),
        assumptions=load_assumptions(config_dir / "assumptions.toml"),
    )


@dataclass
class Consolidation:
    """Everything one run produced, kept so every figure can be traced and every step re-checked."""

    ctx: Context
    findings: list[Finding] = field(default_factory=list)
    mapped: list[MappedLine] = field(default_factory=list)
    dispositions: list[Disposition] = field(default_factory=list)
    local: list[Posting] = field(default_factory=list)
    revalue: RevalueResult | None = None
    ic: IcResult | None = None
    translated: list[Posting] = field(default_factory=list)
    acquisition: AcquisitionFigures | None = None
    eliminations: list[Entry] = field(default_factory=list)
    blocked: str | None = None


def stage(ctx: Context) -> Consolidation:
    """Post, revalue, translate, eliminate, goodwill. A missing input blocks the run from that point; it does not crash."""
    fx = FxTable(ctx.inputs.rates)
    result = Consolidation(ctx=ctx, findings=run_all(ctx))
    try:
        result.mapped = apply_mapping(classified(ctx), ctx.assumptions)
        result.dispositions = decide(ctx.inputs.journals, result.findings, ctx.assumptions)
        local = india_period_postings(import_postings(result.mapped), ctx.inputs)
        local += journal_postings(ctx.inputs, ctx.inputs.journals, result.dispositions)
        result.revalue, result.ic = revalue(result.mapped, fx), reconcile(ctx.inputs, fx)
        for entry in result.revalue.entries + result.ic.entries:
            local += list(entry.lines)
        result.local = local
        result.translated = translate(local, ctx.inputs, fx, ctx.policy.period.end)
        result.acquisition = acquisition_figures(ctx.inputs, fx, local, result.translated)
        residual = ctx.policy.intercompany.residual_account
        result.eliminations = [ic_balances(result.translated), ic_income_expense(result.translated, residual)]
        result.eliminations += investments(ctx.inputs, local, result.translated, result.acquisition)
    except ConsolidationBlocked as stop:
        result.blocked = str(stop)
    return result

"""The 12 control figures, each Determined, Provisional (with its open items) or Unknown (with its reason)."""
from decimal import Decimal

from app.core.acquisition import AcquisitionFigures
from app.core.intercompany import IcResult
from app.core.reserve import ReserveResult
from app.core.revalue import RevalueResult, restated_amount
from app.core.statements import Balances, net_assets, profit, revenue, total_assets
from app.domain.figures import Determined, Figure, Provisional, Unknown
from app.domain.journals import Disposition
from app.domain.runs import Inputs
from app.parsers.fx_rates import FxTable

KEYS = (
    "group_revenue", "group_profit", "profit_owners", "profit_nci", "nci_closing", "goodwill_closing",
    "translation_reserve_movement", "total_assets", "total_equity", "intercompany_difference", "sgd_bank_gbp",
    "journals",
)


def _wrap(value: Decimal, open_items: tuple[str, ...]) -> Figure:
    return Provisional(value=value, open_items=open_items) if open_items else Determined(value=value)


def sgd_figure(inputs: Inputs, fx: FxTable) -> Figure:
    """The UK SGD bank at the closing rate. Without a GBP/SGD closing rate it is Unknown, never an estimate."""
    lines = [line for line in inputs.trial_balances.get("UK", []) if line.txn_ccy == "SGD"]
    amounts = [restated_amount(line, fx) for line in lines]
    if not lines or any(a is None for a in amounts):
        return Unknown(reason="fx_rates.csv has no GBP/SGD closing rate, so the SGD 40,000 bank balance cannot be "
                              "restated; it is carried at its booked GBP value inside total assets")
    return Determined(value=sum((a for a in amounts if a is not None), Decimal(0)))


def build_figures(
    inputs: Inputs, fx: FxTable, balances: Balances, res: ReserveResult, acq: AcquisitionFigures, ic: IcResult,
    dispositions: list[Disposition], rev: RevalueResult,
) -> dict[str, Figure]:
    coa = inputs.coa
    gaps = tuple(
        f"{ln.entity} {ln.local_code} {ln.txn_ccy} {ln.txn_amount} carried at its booked {ln.amount}: no closing rate"
        for ln in rev.unresolved
    )
    suspense = balances.get("UNMAPPED", Decimal(0))
    unmapped = (f"an UNMAPPED balance of {suspense} is carried in a suspense line",) if suspense != 0 else ()
    counts = {"posted": 0, "rejected": 0, "held": 0}
    for d in dispositions:
        counts[{"POST": "posted", "REJECT": "rejected", "HOLD": "held"}[d.status]] += 1
    group_profit = profit(balances, coa)
    return {
        "group_revenue": _wrap(revenue(balances, coa), unmapped),
        "group_profit": _wrap(group_profit, gaps + unmapped),
        "profit_owners": _wrap(res.owners_profit, gaps + unmapped),
        "profit_nci": _wrap(acq.nci_profit, unmapped),
        "nci_closing": _wrap(res.nci_closing, unmapped),
        "goodwill_closing": Determined(value=acq.goodwill_gbp),
        "translation_reserve_movement": _wrap(res.movement_balance, unmapped),
        "total_assets": _wrap(total_assets(balances, coa), gaps + unmapped),
        "total_equity": _wrap(net_assets(balances, coa), gaps + unmapped),
        "intercompany_difference": (
            Determined(value=ic.difference) if ic.difference is not None
            else Unknown(reason="the intercompany difference needs the USD closing rate, which fx_rates.csv does not give")
        ),
        "sgd_bank_gbp": sgd_figure(inputs, fx),
        "journals": Determined(value=counts),
    }

"""Translation reserve (account 3300), worked out by two routes that must agree (assumption A12: 0.01)."""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal

from app.core.acquisition import INDIA, AcquisitionFigures
from app.core.eliminate import INVESTMENT, total
from app.core.statements import Balances, Coa, net_assets, profit
from app.core.translate import ConsolidationBlocked
from app.domain.entries import Posting
from app.domain.runs import Inputs
from app.parsers.fx_rates import FxTable


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ReserveResult:
    opening: Decimal
    closing: Decimal
    movement_balance: Decimal
    movement_components: Decimal
    components: dict[str, Decimal]
    owners_profit: Decimal
    nci_closing: Decimal
    retained_closing: Decimal

    @property
    def difference(self) -> Decimal:
        return self.movement_balance - self.movement_components


def _equity(local: list[Posting], coa: Coa, entity: str, kinds: tuple[str, ...]) -> Decimal:
    return -sum((p.amount for p in local if p.entity == entity and p.account in coa
                 and coa[p.account].account_type in kinds and coa[p.account].statement == "BS"), Decimal(0))


def _entity_profit(local: list[Posting], coa: Coa, entity: str) -> Decimal:
    return -sum((p.amount for p in local if p.entity == entity and p.account in coa and coa[p.account].statement == "PL"),
                Decimal(0))


def _rates(fx: FxTable) -> dict[str, Decimal]:
    wanted = {"usd_close": ("USD", "closing"), "usd_open": ("USD", "opening"), "usd_avg": ("USD", "average"),
              "usd_spot": ("USD", "spot"), "inr_close": ("INR", "closing"), "inr_spot": ("INR", "spot"),

def components(
    inputs: Inputs, fx: FxTable, local: list[Posting], translated: list[Posting], acq: AcquisitionFigures,
) -> dict[str, Decimal]:
    """Policy 2: exchange differences from the opening net assets (closing against opening rate), from profit (closing
    against average) and from India (closing against the completion-date rate), less the differences on the two
    investments, which the group eliminates."""
    r, coa = _rates(fx), inputs.coa
    note, owned = inputs.acquisition, inputs.acquisition.interest_pct / 100
    us_open = _equity(local, coa, "US", ("Equity",))
    us_profit = _entity_profit(local, coa, "US")
    india_profit_inr = _entity_profit(local, coa, INDIA)
    uk_inv, in_inv = total(local, INVESTMENT["UK"], "US"), total(local, INVESTMENT["IN"], "US")
    close_usd, close_inr = 1 / r["usd_close"], 1 / r["inr_close"]
    return {
        "us_opening_net_assets": us_open * (close_usd - 1 / r["usd_open"]),
        "us_profit": us_profit * (close_usd - 1 / r["usd_avg"]),
        "india_net_assets_and_profit_owners": owned * (
            note.net_assets_at_completion * (close_inr - 1 / r["inr_spot"])
            + india_profit_inr * (close_inr - 1 / r["inr_h2"])),

        "uk_investment_retranslation_removed": -uk_inv * (close_usd - 1 / r["usd_open"]),
        "india_investment_retranslation_removed": -in_inv * (close_usd - 1 / r["usd_spot"]),
    }


def reserve(
    inputs: Inputs, fx: FxTable, local: list[Posting], translated: list[Posting], balances: Balances,
    acq: AcquisitionFigures,
) -> ReserveResult:
    """Balance route: equity is fixed by net assets, so the reserve is what is left after capital, retained earnings
    (opening plus owners' profit, assumption A11) and NCI. Components route: the sum of the exchange differences."""
    prior = inputs.prior_equity
    group_profit = profit(balances, inputs.coa)
    owners = group_profit - acq.nci_profit
    nci = prior["3400"].amount_gbp + acq.nci_closing
    retained = prior["3200"].amount_gbp + owners
    closing = net_assets(balances, inputs.coa) - prior["3100"].amount_gbp - retained - nci
    parts = components(inputs, fx, local, translated, acq)
    return ReserveResult(
        opening=prior["3300"].amount_gbp, closing=closing, movement_balance=closing - prior["3300"].amount_gbp,
        movement_components=sum(parts.values(), Decimal(0)), components=parts, owners_profit=owners,
        nci_closing=nci, retained_closing=retained,
    )

from pathlib import Path

        )

import shutil
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

from app.domain.figures import Unknown
from app.domain.runs import Context
from app.services.run_service import build_context, stage
from app.utils.money import round2
from app.utils.paths import CONFIG_DIR, DEFAULT_DATA_DIR
from tests.conftest import Edit


def edited_policy(tmp_path: Path, old: str, new: str) -> Context:
    config = tmp_path / "config"
    shutil.copytree(CONFIG_DIR, config)
    text = (config / "policy.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert old in text
    (config / "policy.toml").write_text(text.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")
    return build_context(DEFAULT_DATA_DIR, config)


def test_the_supplied_policy_text_matches_its_approved_hash(ctx: Context) -> None:
    assert stage(ctx).blocked is None


def test_changing_the_policy_file_without_re_approval_blocks_the_run(edited_context: Edit) -> None:
    run = stage(edited_context("group_policies.md", "Translate at full precision", "Translate at 4 decimals"))
    assert run.blocked is not None and "approve it again" in run.blocked
    assert all(isinstance(f, Unknown) for f in run.figures.values())


def test_the_run_still_finishes_and_lists_its_findings_when_blocked(edited_context: Edit) -> None:
    run = stage(edited_context("group_policies.md", "Translate at full precision", "Translate at 4 decimals"))
    assert run.findings


def test_editing_one_policy_line_changes_the_output(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    ctx = edited_policy(tmp_path, 'difference_account = "7300"\n\n[business_combination]', 'difference_account = "6500"\n\n[business_combination]')
    run = stage(ctx)
    assert round2(run.balances["6500"] - stage(build_context(DEFAULT_DATA_DIR)).balances["6500"]) == Decimal("11957.88")


def test_the_residual_account_for_intercompany_income_is_read_from_the_policy(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    ctx = edited_policy(tmp_path, 'residual_account = "7300"', 'residual_account = "6500"')
    income = next(e for e in stage(ctx).eliminations if e.id == "ELIM-IC-INCOME")
    assert [p.account for p in income.lines] == ["4200", "6300", "6500"]

"""Binds config/policy.toml to group_policies.md by hash: change the text without re-approval and the run blocks."""
from pathlib import Path

from app.domain.policy import Policy
from app.utils.hashing import sha256_file


class PolicyBlocked(Exception):
    """group_policies.md no longer matches the text policy.toml was approved against."""


def check_binding(policy: Policy, data_dir: Path) -> None:
    """Policy-dependent steps cannot run on a policy nobody approved. Re-approve by updating source_sha256."""
    source = data_dir / Path(policy.meta.source).name
    actual = sha256_file(source)
    if actual != policy.meta.source_sha256:
        raise PolicyBlocked(
            f"{source.name} has changed since config/policy.toml was approved (hash {actual[:12]}, approved "
            f"{policy.meta.source_sha256[:12]}): re-read the policy and approve it again before the run continues"
        )

import shutil
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

from app.domain.figures import Unknown
from app.domain.runs import Context
from app.services.run_service import build_context, stage
from app.utils.money import round2
from app.utils.paths import CONFIG_DIR, DEFAULT_DATA_DIR
from tests.conftest import Edit


def edited_policy(tmp_path: Path, old: str, new: str) -> Context:
    config = tmp_path / "config"
    shutil.copytree(CONFIG_DIR, config)
    text = (config / "policy.toml").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert old in text
    (config / "policy.toml").write_text(text.replace(old, new), encoding="utf-8")
    return build_context(DEFAULT_DATA_DIR, config)


def test_the_supplied_policy_text_matches_its_approved_hash(ctx: Context) -> None:
    assert stage(ctx).blocked is None


def test_changing_the_policy_file_without_re_approval_blocks_the_run(edited_context: Edit) -> None:
    run = stage(edited_context("group_policies.md", "Translate at full precision", "Translate at 4 decimals"))
    assert run.blocked is not None and "approve it again" in run.blocked
    assert all(isinstance(f, Unknown) for f in run.figures.values())


def test_the_run_still_finishes_and_lists_its_findings_when_blocked(edited_context: Edit) -> None:
    run = stage(edited_context("group_policies.md", "Translate at full precision", "Translate at 4 decimals"))
    assert run.findings


def test_editing_one_policy_line_changes_the_output(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    ctx = edited_policy(tmp_path, 'difference_account = "7300"\n\n[business_combination]', 'difference_account = "6500"\n\n[business_combination]')
    run = stage(ctx)
    assert round2(run.balances["6500"] - stage(build_context(DEFAULT_DATA_DIR)).balances["6500"]) == Decimal("11957.88")


def test_the_residual_account_for_intercompany_income_is_read_from_the_policy(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    ctx = edited_policy(tmp_path, 'residual_account = "7300"', 'residual_account = "6500"')
    income = next(e for e in stage(ctx).eliminations if e.id == "ELIM-IC-INCOME")
    assert [p.account for p in income.lines] == ["4200", "6300", "6500"]
